params.name: model
params.description: AI model used to process the audio. Options include nova-3, nova-2, nova, enhanced, and base.

params.name: language
params.description: BCP-47 language tag for the primary spoken language in the audio.

params.name: punctuate
params.description: Indicates whether to add punctuation and capitalization to the transcript.

params.name: diarize
params.description: Indicates whether to recognize speaker changes in the transcript.

params.name: diarize_version
params.description: Version of the diarization feature to use.

params.name: smart_format
params.description: Indicates whether to apply smart formatting which synchronizes punctuation, diarization, and intelligent text normalization.

params.name: utterances
params.description: Indicates whether to segment speech into utterances.

params.name: utt_split
params.description: Length of time in seconds used to split utterances.

params.name: keywords
params.description: Keywords to boost in the transcription results.

params.name: search
params.description: Terms to search for in the submitted audio.

params.name: replace
params.description: Terms or phrases to search for in the submitted audio and replace.

params.name: redact
params.description: Indicates whether to redact sensitive information from the transcript. Accepts boolean or specific entity types such as pci, numbers, ssn.

params.name: paragraphs
params.description: Indicates whether to split the transcript into paragraphs.

params.name: detect_language
params.description: Indicates whether to detect the language of the audio.

params.name: filler_words
params.description: Indicates whether to include filler words such as um and uh in the transcript.

params.name: multichannel
params.description: Indicates whether to transcribe each audio channel independently.

params.name: alternatives
params.description: Maximum number of transcript alternatives to return.

params.name: numerals
params.description: Indicates whether to convert numbers from written format to numerical format.

params.name: tag
params.description: Tag to associate with the request for tracking purposes.

params.name: callback
params.description: URL to which Deepgram will make a callback request when processing is complete.

params.name: callback_method
params.description: HTTP method for the callback request.

params.name: sentiment
params.description: Indicates whether to perform sentiment analysis on the content.

params.name: summarize
params.description: Indicates whether to generate a summary of the content. Can be a boolean or a specific summary format.

params.name: topics
params.description: Indicates whether to detect topics in the content.

params.name: intents
params.description: Indicates whether to detect intents in the content.

params.name: extra
params.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs to associate with the request.

items.docs: Transcribes and optionally analyzes pre-recorded audio. Accepts audio as a URL reference in the request body or as raw binary audio data. Supports a wide range of audio formats and provides options for punctuation, diarization, smart formatting, language detection, summarization, sentiment analysis, topic detection, and intent recognition through query parameters.
